issues.description: Solution for Aufgabe 05 does not implement the required aggregation: the problem asks for the average area (durchschnittliche Fläche) per Landkreis (kreis) plus the Landkreis name and regierungsbezirk, but the solution selects the column `kreis` twice and aliases one copy as `avg_flaeche` instead of using an aggregation function (e.g. AVG(flaeche)). This means the solution returns a text/string value for the column named avg_flaeche rather than the numeric average requested, contradicting the problem specification and misleading students about how to use GROUP BY and aggregate functions.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect selection of `kreis as avg_flaeche` with an actual aggregation of the area, for example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) AS avg_flaeche FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis; This returns the numeric average area per Landkreis as requested and matches the problem description.
